claim_one_line: TWO MORE CLUSTERS RESTORED -- AND RE-VERIFYING THEM FOUND TWO DEFECTS IN WHAT WAS ABOUT TO BE RESTORED. Restorations 2 and 3 of B1037's seven, under campaign step 5 ('re-verify the identities before restoring, NEVER restore from memory'), chosen not by size but by what this sandbox can honestly redo: snappy, cypari, cypari2, sage and flint are all absent here, so restoring an arc on citation alone WOULD BE restoring from memory. FOUR debt rows become TWO curated laws. LAW 1 (B141 + B142) -- FINITENESS VERSUS DENSITY SPLITS THE TOWER: the two towers are told apart by a determinant sign before any representation is built, the phi-map A -> AB, B -> A abelianising to [[1,1],[1,0]] with det -1 and trace 1 (golden, discrete fixed points) against the bundle monodromy sigma_R o sigma_L abelianising to [[2,1],[1,1]] = A = LR with det +1 and trace 3 (phi-squared, hyperbolic); the phi-side tower is REDUCIBLE at every SL(n) for n >= 3 while the phi-squared side stays IRREDUCIBLE in Q(sqrt-3). THE BRIDGE EQUATION DOES THE SELECTING: the induced trace map (x,y,z) -> (z, x, xz-y), DERIVED here from Cayley-Hamilton on generic det-1 matrices rather than quoted, has exactly two fixed points -- (2,2,2) with kappa = 2 (the cancellation completes, NOTHING, reducible) and (0,0,0) with kappa = -2 -- so the unique irreducible phi-fixed point is FORCED, and its group is Q8. Q8's five conjugacy classes force five irreps and sum of squares = 8 over five parts has the unique solution 1+1+1+1+2, so MAX IRREP DIM 2 IS DERIVED HERE, NOT QUOTED FROM A CHARACTER TABLE; with dim Sym^{n-1} = n > 2 for all n >= 3 the tower is reducible, and the algebra-dimension table reproduces B141 exactly at 4,3,4,4,4,4 against n^2 for n = 2..7 -- irreducible at n = 2 ONLY. DEFECT 1, A FALSE STATEMENT NARROWLY AVERTED: B141 Item 3's slogan 'finite image => reducible tower' is FALSE as a general implication, falsified in-sandbox by the binary tetrahedral group SL(2,3), which is FINITE (order 24) and whose Sym^2 is IRREDUCIBLE (algebra dim 9 = 3^2). The real bound is the MAXIMAL IRREP DIMENSION d, giving reducibility for every n > d -- 2 for Q8, 3 for SL(2,3) -- and the two groups sit on OPPOSITE SIDES of their own bound at exactly n = 3, so the bound is sharp and finiteness alone is not the reason. B141's conclusion survives untouched; only its stated mechanism was too strong, and it is restored in the narrowed form. DEFECT 2, AN UNSTATED HYPOTHESIS: B142's one-line Klein-4 proof opens 'principal eigenvalues {1,-1,-1} => A^2 = I', which needs A SEMISIMPLE -- the Jordan matrix diag(1) + [[-1,1],[0,-1]] has the same spectrum and det 1 and is NOT an involution, verified here. The hypothesis does hold at a phi-fixed point, where A is conjugate to diag(1,-1,-1) by fiat, so the proof is sound; it was simply never written down. AND B142'S PROBE NEVER VERIFIED ITS OWN LEMMA: klein4_lemma_symbolic() exhibits ONE commuting pair, so the universally quantified statement (two involutions whose product is an involution commute) is verified here for the first time, as a group identity -- <a,b | a^2, b^2, (ab)^2> has order 4 and trivial commutator, by coset enumeration. LAW 2 (B154 + B198) -- THE PERIPHERAL EXPONENT IS ORDER-DETERMINED, NOT RANK-DETERMINED: on the metallic bundle phi_m = sigma_R^m o sigma_L^m the monodromy preserves the fibre boundary only UP TO CONJUGACY, phi_m([A,B]) = A^m [A,B] A^-m, an EXACT FREE-GROUP IDENTITY verified by word reduction for m = 1..10 where B154 verified m = 1,2 -- and the induction for general m was never written down, a gap CARRIED rather than closed. From it mu = A^-m t is peripheral in one line given only the mapping-torus relation t X t^-1 = phi(X), which DEFINES the bundle. AND THE MERIDIAN'S EXPONENT IS FORCED, NOT FITTED: A^-k t is peripheral ONLY at k = m, checked for m = 1,2,3 across k = 0..6 and unique every time, because in a free group A^j commutes with [A,B] only at j = 0. Abelianisation confirms the family, ab(phi_m) = M_m^2 with trace m^2+2, for m = 1..7. B198's SL(5) o=5 k=2 is RE-CHECKED AGAINST ITS BANKED CERTIFICATE rather than re-searched -- the right move for a claim whose evidence IS a certificate -- giving ||[A,B] - mu^2|| = 1.55e-19 at dps 40 with neighbours excluded at 3.878 and 8.230 against B198's quoted 3.9 and 8.2, Burnside rank 25 of 25, ||mu - t|| = 2.1876 against 2.19, and mu loxodromic of INFINITE order, i.e. on the geometric/cusped stratum. AND THE COUNTEREXAMPLE THAT KILLS EVERY CLOSED FORM WAS RE-RUN IN-SANDBOX, by invoking B198's own reproducer rather than reimplementing it (the B1033 pattern): on the order(mu) = infinity stratum o=4 and o=8 BOTH give k=3, 8/8 reps each, where k = 7-o predicts 3 and -1 and k = 4-m(o-3) likewise. Both REFUTED, measured rather than remembered. TWO SCOPE QUALIFIERS TRAVEL WITH THE ROW OR IT IS AN OVERCLAIM: (i) B199's correction, that the rigid identity holds on a dim-2 SUBLOCUS at ~1% of irreducible loxodromic reps (8/887, 24/3486) and NOT on the geometric component, the err<1e-6 filter having SELECTED that sublocus so that '305/305 unanimous' was a FILTER ARTIFACT -- read k = 2 at the COMPLETE CUSPED REP, noting that at SL(3) it does hold component-wide and the sublocus phenomenon emerges with rank; (ii) that every closed form is refuted, including the one still printed above B154's own correction banner, so restoring that line without the banner would restore a refuted claim -- the same trap B1037 caught at B123.
